newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: Japanese shares were little changed in thin trade on Monday following a sluggish session in Tokyo overnight, dealers said.
"The Nikkei didn't do much today. With the market shut tomorrow for the New Year holiday, we won't see much business in Europe," one dealer said.
In Tokyo on Monday, stocks went out with a whimper on the last trading day of 1996 as players wondered what the New Year would bring for the Japanese economy and currencies.
The key Nikkei-225 average finished down 7.69 points at 19,361.35, around 500 points below its 1995 close.
In London, the Nikke/ISE-50 index was up 1.37 at 1,427.39 by 1220 GMT.
